examples.explanation: Take [6,5] from the first array and [9,8,3] from the second, interleaved as 9,8,6,5,3.
Using every digit of both arrays in order gives the only (hence best) length-5 number.
Keeping 9 from the first array and 8,9 from the second yields 9,8,9, the maximum.

hints: Try every split of k into i digits from nums1 and k-i from nums2.
The best i-length subsequence of one array comes from a monotonic stack that drops smaller digits while enough remain.
Merging two subsequences greedily by lexicographic suffix comparison yields the best interleave.
